Definition: neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of G4862 and the base of G1476; a joint session, i.e. (specially), the Jewish Sanhedrin; by analogy, a subordinate tribunal:--council.
BiblicalUsage: The chief priests and elders and all the council seek false witness against Jesus to put Him to death, and they lead Him into their council at dawn and ask whether He is the Christ. The same council sets the apostles before it and forbids them to preach, and Paul stands before it and says he has lived in all good conscience before God until this day. The council is the highest court of Israel, and it spends its power against the very men God sent.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that earthly courts can be wrong about heaven's business, and I hold that a good conscience before God is the only verdict that finally matters. I take Paul's stand as my own: I have lived before God, and no council can take that from me.
